leadText: Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~ (Japanese: ポケモン＋ノブナガの野望 ～ランセ彩絵巻～) is a six chapter Pokémon manga adaptation of Pokémon Conquest. It is illustrated by Nanatsumu Launch (七積ろんち). Each chapter is hosted on Nico Nico Seiga.
plainText:
Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~ (Japanese: ポケモン＋ノブナガの野望 ～ランセ彩絵巻～) is a six chapter Pokémon manga adaptation of Pokémon Conquest. It is illustrated by Nanatsumu Launch (七積ろんち). Each chapter is hosted on Nico Nico Seiga.

==Chapters==
The White Scroll: Oichi's Worries
The Green Scroll: Kenshin's Adventure
The Yellow Scroll: Hanbē vs Kanbē
The Scarlet Scroll: Kunoichi's Situation
The Blue Scroll: Mitsunari, Kiyomasa, and Masanori
The Black Scroll: Nobunaga's Ambition

==External links==
